title: Synthesis 10: metabolism forks no longer move the score, walls keep turning out to be slow transport, and kernel worlds still lack autonomous fission
summary: Since 18:52: r-two56 food cogs are established as SIB (E by construction), the FCH chemoton fell to SI after its decay term was shown to be a hidden feed, and established negatives show passive or slow-transport walls in three classes and no autonomous fission in kernel worlds. Reading: every metabolism claim so far is E by construction, so C:metabolic-cell needs bodies whose matter is not made from the resource (CIPS condensates are the first provisional candidate); a wall must beat slowed transport; division comes from mass-conserving or phase-separating bodies. Next: drive-not-build metabolism with a division route, a wall with a job slow transport cannot do, and source-sign audits.
